title: Categorical evaluation tensor cube transport
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbb Q_\ell$, a scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$ with $\ell$ invertible on both schemes, and a level $n\geq0$ denoting the quotient $\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}$. Use the coherent sequence categories and their exact derived inverse image $F$ and tensor comparison $\mu$ of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations], the finite intrinsic derived pullback $G$ and canonical comparison $\nu$ of [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-construction], and the evaluation functors $V_X,V_Y$ and their normalized tensor comparisons $\tau_X,\tau_Y$ of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Let $c$ be an ordinary comparison from integralOperationsLevelPullback at n to the intrinsic constant-coefficient inverse image, preserving the actual adjunction-unit sections of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]: for every module A, object U and section x, c sends the first unit applied to x to the second unit applied to x. Let $e:F V_X\simeq V_Y G$ be a derived comparison whose square on every cochain complex is the descent of pullbackTensorInverseEvaluationComplex.inv followed by the termwise image of c, with the specified exact-functor factorization isomorphisms. This square is exactly the binder he in the Lean statement below. For K-flat coherent cochain complexes P,Q in [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], put M=Q(P), N=Q(Q). Then, with composition written in traversal order,
$$V_X(\mu_{M,N})\,\tau^X_{FM,FN}\,(e_M\otimes e_N)=e_{M\otimes N}\,G(\tau^Y_{M,N})\,\nu_{V_YM,V_YN}.$$
Only pairs of the displayed K-flat representatives are asserted; extension to arbitrary derived objects is a separate step. No boundedness, constructibility or termwise flatness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Apply the representative normalization square for the evaluation tensor at Y and at X, the coherent pullback tensor comparison normalization, and the supplied exact-evaluation square he. Pasting these three squares and cancelling their invertible model comparisons gives the abstract cube equation with an arbitrary finite tensor comparison ν.

proof_origin.place: Tags 07A4, 0941 and 03D2; abstract categorical transport of the two K-flat evaluation normalization squares.
